review_status: Passed numerical and rendered-skin review of the final bound production blend.
limits: Support timing follows inspected capture phases after proportion fitting; force/pressure is not measured.
Slip is tested at the manifest speed on level ground, independent of Unity or gameplay pathfinding.
Sole centroids are sampled skin vertices, not a biomechanical pressure centroid.
Floor contact and loop velocity may have small bounded residuals; do not claim absolute zero skating.

visual_review.method: Nine actual evaluated-skin renders inspected: four side poses per gait plus one run three-quarter pose.
visual_review.finding_ko: 뒤꿈치가 반대로 접히거나 앞다리가 완전히 접히는 문제를 수정했고, 검토한 자세에서 뚜렷한 관통이나 갑작스러운 다리 뒤집힘이 보이지 않습니다.
visual_review.finding_en: Reversed hocks and completely folded elbows are resolved; reviewed poses show no obvious penetration or abrupt limb reversal.
visual_review.limits: Rendered pose sampling is visual QA, not an exhaustive mesh self-intersection or biomechanics proof.

numerical_checks.criterion: Anatomical elbow, stifle, and hock sagittal directions retained at all samples
All four skinned paw loop endpoints within 0.1 mm
No sampled skinned paw step exceeds 50 mm at 120 Hz
Interior support sole floor within -1 mm to +1 mm
Supported weighted sole drift below 5 mm at declared forward speed
Stable signed quaternion seam angular-velocity difference below 15 degrees/s
